what: Hovering the round button spins it 375° (one full turn plus 15° — the tilted text stands upright right away) while swapping its background, text and border colors. With back.inOut(2.5) .5s it winds back slightly before spinning, then overshoots and settles upright. On release it rewinds along the same path.

options.turn: Rotation angle (deg), default 375 — social circle is 360
options.ease: Curve, default back.inOut(2.5) — either the ”0.16,1,0.3,1” form or a GSAP name

use: View product · social circle: data-fx-spin-swap-hover="turn: 360; ease: back.inOut(1.7)" style="--fx-on-bg: var(--kf-ink); --fx-on-ink: var(--kf-bg)"
note: Rotation is applied with transform — if you tilt it using the rotate property (css), the two stack and add up. With reduced motion, it doesn’t rotate and the color just changes immediately

from.where: shared.js HS.hoverSpin (.hs-round round View product·Contact buttons)
